markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (80%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged frozen-section reliability (32%) leaves Benign vs Normal unresolved; margin call deferred [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 80%, Normal 15%, InSitu 4%, Invasive 1% [F1] | Low invasive risk (1%) |
| Conformal set | Benign, Normal (alpha 10%) | Benign vs Normal unresolved |
| Reliability / OOD | 32% reliability (flagged), 88% OOD [F6] | Suspect input; recut/levels drafted |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Models disagree on class |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign, 3/5 Normal (86%–89%) [F5] | Mixed Benign/Normal reference neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.17, contribution -0.68) pushes against invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Typical (0.24, contribution +0.22); spot-check 12/20 [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Typical (0.41); descriptive only, spot-check 8/20 [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Low (0.07, contribution -0.14) pushes against invasion · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-risk removal drops invasive risk above random (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20) unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Resampling degradation (32% reliability, 88% OOD) masks frozen-section morphology; review drafted recut and deeper levels.
- Inferior margin (77% probability) or regions 11 (32% risk) and 8 (20% risk) harbor unsampled lesion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 11, 8**: Inspect highest heatmap risk (32%, 20%) and inferior margin (77% probability; call deferred).
2. **Regions 7, 9**: Verify absent stromal invasion and nuclear pleomorphism where concept scores peaked.
3. **Regions 1, 4, 6**: Check duct confinement, TILs, and stroma on recut/deeper levels.
